actions: Restored the pinned BOPTEST v0.9.0 bestest_air FMU and verified its SHA-256 against the existing development artifact.
Installed FMPy 0.3.22 and compatible isolated dependencies in the local .venv.
Attempted a read-only clone of the official project1-boptest v0.9.0 tag into /private/tmp with and without network escalation.
Did not run E15 or consume an existing one-shot study.
blockers: The isolated .venv can install FMPy 0.3.22 only with Python 3.9 compatibility overrides; msgpack 1.0.8 was used because msgpack 1.2.2 required a local compiler.
The pinned FMU contains only binaries/linux64/wrapped.so (ELF x86-64) and no darwin64 library, so FMPy on macOS ARM cannot instantiate it.
The day-270 attempt failed before the first FMU transition with a missing darwin64 shared-library error; no holdout metric was produced.
required_before_retry: Provide a Linux x86-64 runtime (or a separately verified compatible FMU build) for the pinned binary.
Select a date or initial state not used for parameter selection.
Run the locked controller once and preserve trace, metrics, and SHA-256.
interpretation: No numeric holdout claim is made. The protocol remains PILOT_INCOMPLETE rather than being filled with synthetic or hand-entered values.
